title: Tearful Kostyuk speaks of Ukraine missile attack after 'most difficult' French Open win
summary: An emotional Marta Kostyuk fought back tears after her first-round win at the French Open on Sunday as she told the Roland Garros crowd about waking up to news that a Russian missile had struck near her parents' home in Ukraine.
contentText: Novak Djokovic rallied from a set down to keep alive his bid for a record 25th Grand Slam title at the French Open on Sunday, overcoming France's Giovanni Mpetshi Perricard in the opening round. Alexander Zverev advanced more comfortably as the clay-court major got underway in Paris.
